entities.summary: Thorsten Flinck (b. 1961-04-17, Solna Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Solna Municipality and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
